permission.title: Camera access needed
permission.body: Path2Class uses your camera to overlay directions onto the corridor in real time. Your video feed never leaves your device.

ar.instruction_accessible: Turn left to the elevator, 8 m
ar.next_line: Next: Room 17 W on your left

steps.0: Point the camera at the corridor to begin.
steps.1: Turn right. Elevator ahead, bin on your left, painting on your right.
steps.2: Go straight. Walk through the doors in front of you.
steps.4: Go straight. Room 124 at the end on your right.

steps_standard.text: Leave the corridor entrance, walk straight 12 m.
Pass Room 17 W on your left.
Room 124 on your right. Blue door sign.

steps_accessible.text: Turn left at entrance to reach elevator (8 m).
Exit elevator, turn right into corridor.
Continue straight. Room 124 on your right.

assistant.welcome: Hi! I can help you navigate, simplify instructions, or answer questions about this corridor.

guided.intro: Great — I'll guide you step by step. Answer Yes or No to each question, or describe what you see in your own words.
guided.didnt_understand: I didn't catch that. Tap a button or reply with yes or no.

1.message: Scan the QR code at the entrance. In front of you there should be the elevators, with a bin on your left and a painting on your right. Do you see them?
1.help: Look around. Find the elevators and the bin near the corridor entrance, then answer.

2.message: Great. Now turn right — there should be a door in front of you. Can you see it?
2.help: Make sure you turned right. Then look ahead: there's a door to walk through.

3.message: Walk through the door and continue straight. Do you see doors on your left and a sign on your right?
3.help: Keep going straight a few more steps. You should see a sign on the right and doors on the left.

4.message: Turn right at the sign. You should now see the sign on your right and a ventilation grille on your left. Is that right?
4.help: Make sure you turned right. The ventilation grille is on the left wall.

5.message: Continue straight to the end. Do you see a door on your right? That's Room 124.
5.help: Keep walking straight a bit more. Room 124 is at the end of the corridor, on your right.
